result.title: BRAT: Bounded Residual-Aligned Training for Stable Multi-Pass LLM Post-Training
result.summary: Reinforcement learning for large language model post-training often reuses each batch of sampled rollouts for several gradient passes to amortize the cost of generation. Under such multi-pass reuse, existing objectives fail in different ways: unclipped updates collapse as the policy drifts away from the sampling policy, adding a negative baseline avoids collapse but reinforces every sampled response, and PPO-style ratio clipping cuts off gradients abruptly. We first ask why reuse is fragile. Measuring how well an update estimated from a small rollout group aligns with the KL-regularized target on held-out rollouts of the same prompts, we find that this alignment drops by nearly an order of magnitude from in-sample to held-out rollouts across three base models, suggesting that repeated passes largely overfit the sampled group. Motivated by this finding, we propose Bounded Residual-Aligned Training (BRAT), motivated by a proximal update toward a bounded reweighting of the sampling policy. BRAT assigns each token a gradient weight that decreases linearly with its probability ratio and vanishes at a trust-region boundary, and normalizes group-centered rewards by their maximum magnitude, keeping advantages zero-mean and bounded without extra hyperparameters. With four reuse passes, BRAT avoids training collapse, limits policy drift, and achieves higher average accuracy with lower seed variance on most benchmarks.

AI.brief_summary: 论文研究 LLM 强化学习后训练中同一批 rollout 多次梯度复用导致的失稳，提出 BRAT：用随概率比线性衰减、在信赖域边界归零的 token 级梯度权重，并对组中心奖励按最大幅值归一化以保持优势有界。
AI.relevance_reason: 不涉及视觉或多模态推理；但其「重复使用同批轨迹会过拟合采样组」的诊断与信赖域内有界重加权，可能为 latent 推理轨迹训练的贡献分配与稳定性提供借鉴，可供核查其在长链稀疏奖励下的适用性。
